title: NEW (cff3f88) files read by OLD build (b8c11c8) - installer rollback across AUD-05

legacy_observed.behaviour: OLD ignores schema_version/install.json/.bak, manages the lots and rewrites state.json (keeps the v1 label, .bak left stale); NEW later reads it back with no sign an older writer ran

violates: D4 explicit exchange/state reconciliation before management resumes

nc02_required.R-GEN-MONOTONIC: every store write carries (generation, writer_build, format_version, min_reader_version); a reader that sees a generation written by a newer build, or a lower generation than the highest it has seen (rollback/stale copy), aborts read-only (R-ABORT-RO)

note: inputs are untouched NEW output; reader is the pre-AUD-05 build
